# Phoolkari Decor Studio

> Luxury Wedding Decorators & Event Planners in Amritsar, Punjab, India.

Phoolkari Decor Studio is a premier luxury event planning and decoration company founded by Creative Director Mukesh N Aggarwal, based in Amritsar, Punjab. The studio specializes in royal Punjabi wedding decor, grand mandap architecture, exotic floral cascades, and high-end event production.

## Core Services

- **Luxury Wedding Decor** (`https://www.phoolkaridecorstudio.in/services/wedding-decor`): Custom royal mandaps, Haldi & Mehndi marigold setups, Sangeet backdrops, and grand crystal reception stages.
- **Corporate Event Management** (`https://www.phoolkaridecorstudio.in/services/corporate-events`): Award galas, product launches, corporate conferences, and annual ceremonies.
- **Birthday & Anniversary Celebrations** (`https://www.phoolkaridecorstudio.in/services/birthday-parties`): Themed milestone birthdays, anniversaries, and custom neon installations.
- **Festival & Cultural Decor** (`https://www.phoolkaridecorstudio.in/services/festival-decor`): Diwali lighting, Lohri bonfire setups, and traditional cultural festival styling.

## Key Venue Experience in Punjab

- Taj Swarna, Amritsar
- Radisson Blu Hotel, Amritsar
- Hyatt Regency, Amritsar
- Heritage Haveli & Luxury Farmhouses across Amritsar, Jalandhar, and Ludhiana
